text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Meooowww! All the good luck I gathered up 
doesn't even work against Doto-san~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I surrender! You truly are... the blessed 
child of the Buddha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto won the race against 
Matikanefukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's come to this... to celebrate 
our victory, I shall bestow all of this 
good fortune upon you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "O light! Descend upon Doto-san from me!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh... What is this light...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Doto-san, despite calling myself your best 
friend, I wasn't able to do anything for 
you. That is why...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
At least take this mysterious good luck 
with you! Think of it as a good luck charm 
from me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"There will surely be many hardships and 
tribulations ahead, but as long as we have 
this light, we'll be fine!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"It'll definitely make you feel lucky 
somehow! I don't have any real proof, 
though!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling so lucky...! Th-Thank you very 
much, Master Fukukitaruuuu...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I will move forward alongside this light~! 
So I won't lose to any baseless 
pessimism~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A ritual of blessing. While its true 
efficacy remained a mystery, it seemed 
Matikanefukukitaru had challenged her with 
the intention of bestowing good fortune 
upon her from the very start."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! What a magnificent drama of 
succession! And it seems the time has 
finally come!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-Opera O-san!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Brava! A toast to your victory! And may 
honor grace the road ahead of us!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come, Doto. To the promised land. To the 
festival of spring—the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I shall extend the invitation myself— if 
you possess the resolve to become my 
knight!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O-san's knight...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, can I do it? Right now... can I 
protect Opera O-san!?
choice_data_list: Of course you can, without a doubt!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much~! In that case...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san, I'm counting on you for the 
Takarazuka Kinen, pleeeaaase!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A bright, ringing voice echoed out. After 
a long journey of steady effort, Meisho 
Doto had finally reached the side of the 
one she admired.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, with how it felt today... I'm 
sure we can take on the Senior GⅠ races.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
My body and mind are stronger now, and my 
luck too...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Kuh-kuh-kuh-kuh-kuh... Hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That was a flawless victory, Doto.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, Shakur-san?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't get it twisted, though. Me winning 
today wasn't because of fuzzy nonsense 
like heart or body conditioning.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Today, your numbers were simply 
sufficient. It's as damn simple as that."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh, but Shakur-san... didn't you say 
before that you "lacked something"...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, because the contents of the vessel 
weren't filled.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even if your capacity is huge, you'll lose 
if what's inside comes up short. If you've 
got enough, you'll win. You might be 
clumsy, but you had the capacity right 
from the start.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And there was someone who kept pouring 
water into that vessel. Without being 
blinded by mere sentimentality, that is.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: The one who kept pouring water into me...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"You couldn't do something like that 
unless you were by her side the entire 
time, right...? Um..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: !? Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The words Air Shakur told me had 
definitely been on my mind. That's why 
I've always kept a close eye on the 
training data.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her times had steadily, quietly improved 
since her debut. Perhaps today, that 
progress finally took tangible form.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But—here's where the real problem starts. 
The vessels are full. Every last one of 
them.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
A comeback from here is in another 
dimension. A challenge against the 
threshold—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It might bring nothing but despair, Doto. 
To you, challenging the older generation, 
and to Opera O as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"And then... to me, as I head into the 
Classic Triple Crown."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Shakur-san...
